verdicts.reason: A reads well as a left-to-right banner: a large jar, then the headline block, then the CTA. But the NEW badge has shrunk to a tiny sticker floating above the headline, and the CTA is stranded far right with a wide gap. In B the jar is shrunk and pushed close to the left edge, and the illegible NEW badge sits below the subcopy, which breaks reading order and separates it from the product. A large dead zone also sits between the text and the CTA.
